design_brief.problem_statement: Governed R2 continuous run fails first at ordinal #50 M7 recovery. The first failed semantic action is seed beacon pickup; hotbar/recovery/continued-mutation failures cascade from that seed failure.
design_brief.current_behavior: The seed client submits exactly 12 blocking movement intents and then attempts item.pickup. Blocking success proves input-sequence acknowledgement, not that the server-authoritative interaction origin has entered the 5m pickup/visibility precondition. Fixed-tick snapshot phase can therefore make the fixed command count a timing assumption.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Seed setup advances until the authoritative client record proves a conservative pickup-ready spatial distance, then publishes a final authoritative facing update before item.pickup. It fails closed with explicit evidence if readiness is not reached within a bounded maximum.
alternatives_considered: Increase timeout or retry failed pickup
Make the test helper prove the existing server precondition directly
design_brief.selected_design: Keep product authority unchanged. Replace the fixed 12-step assumption in tools/runtime/m7_playable_recovery_client.gd with a bounded authoritative-readiness loop and explicit diagnostic details. Add a pure support regression for the step-budget/readiness policy.
design_brief.why_selected: It repairs the test/setup race at its owner, preserves product semantics, avoids retries and timeout inflation, and turns an implicit scheduler assumption into an explicit precondition.
expected_risks: Readiness threshold too close to server limit
Diagnostic helper accidentally trusts predicted instead of authoritative state
Bounded loop masks a movement failure instead of surfacing it
validation_plan: Static/pure regression of insufficient legacy minimum-progress budget and readiness threshold
fresh Project Control and exact-head source identity
